working_title: Reuse or Retrain? Label-efficient geographic transfer of cached Earth embeddings
primary_question: When source-region training labels are limited and the target region remains unlabeled, does a frozen OlmoEarth cache plus a small decoder transfer better than the strongest matched raw temporal model?
not_answered_by_this_experiment: What to do when k labels are available inside the new target region. That requires a spatially disjoint target-adaptation design.

primary: P4 frozen OlmoEarth v1 cache + small decoder
arms.selection_disclosure: P2 is chosen as the primary raw curve after its 100% macro exceeded P3. This retrospective arm selection is declared before any low-budget result is opened.

subset.selection: For every seed and stratum, sort sample IDs by SHA-256(seed || NUL || sample_id) and take the ceil(fraction * stratum_size) prefix.
report: loader batches and dropped examples per epoch

new_run_count.formula: 3 fractions x 2 arms x 8 folds x 3 subset seeds x 3 optimizer seeds
new_run_count.rule: Complete the remaining 288 irrespective of the direction of the first 144, unless a predeclared engineering invariant fails. The 144-run stage cannot support the paper conclusion.

supervision_contract.training_label_fraction: fraction applies only to train split
supervision_contract.validation_labels: full source validation region remains fixed; therefore this is not a total-label-budget claim
supervision_contract.embedding_normalization: compute once from the full unlabeled source train pool, never from target data
supervision_contract.pos_weight: compute from the labeled subset only

optimization.current_primary_candidate: 40 epochs, same current arm recipes, best source-val checkpoint
must_resolve_before_preregistration: current vs official-like raw recipe audit
drop_last true vs false and whether 100% must be rerun
whether validation frequency remains every epoch
whether arm-specific source-selected recipes or one controlled recipe is primary
optimization.forbidden: Do not change epochs, loss, update budget, augmentation, or subset rule after opening low-budget target metrics.

evaluation.primary_candidate: positive-tile macro IoU at a source-validation-selected threshold under a predeclared empty-tile false-positive budget
secondary: positive-tile macro IoU at threshold 0.5 for continuity
cache bytes and cache construction cost
evaluation.aggregation: equal-weight region macro; nested uncertainty over region, subset seed, then optimizer seed
evaluation.crossover_rule: Estimate a crossover only if observed curves cross. Otherwise report no observed crossover through 100%; do not extrapolate one.
evaluation.forbidden_independence_claim: The 432 runs are not 432 independent geographic samples.

gates_before_gpu: DONE: C1b compact artifact exists and verifies 24/24 source hashes
raw recipe audit is frozen using source-only validation
DONE: all nested subset IDs and counts are sealed without reading model metrics
one CPU loader smoke confirms identical IDs across arms and no target leakage
evaluation threshold and false-positive budget are fixed
claim_if_positive: Under label-limited source supervision with an unlabeled target region, cached frozen OlmoEarth features provide a better label-compute transfer frontier than the selected matched raw temporal baseline.
claim_if_no_crossover: No raw-model crossover was observed up to the full source-label budget under this S12q protocol.
claim_if_negative: The full-data reuse gain does not persist under label-sampling uncertainty; report the budget and regions where it fails without changing the endpoint or subset rule.
